title: Wave Model Forecast on UK 1.5km Wave Standard Grid
source: Met Office Operational Suite, WAVEWATCH III

grid.note: cell centres half a cell in from the edges; row 0 north, column 0 west

windsea.gb: propagation direction (x east, y north) = byte / 127.5 - 1

swell.r: primary swell significant height, m = byte * 0.05
swell.gb: propagation direction (x east, y north) = byte / 127.5 - 1

period.g: primary swell peak period, s = byte * 0.1
